name: io.github.veracium-ai/veracium
description: Provenance-aware memory for AI agents: quarantine, abstention gate, supersession-with-history.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the reference Anthropic provider

environmentVariables.name: VERACIUM_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite memory file (default: veracium.db)

environmentVariables.name: VERACIUM_USER
environmentVariables.description: The deployment's user id: every tool acts on it; no tool takes a user_id (the host process is the identity boundary)

environmentVariables.name: VERACIUM_MCP_CAPABILITY
environmentVariables.description: The host's attestation about every call on this server (specs/0031). Unset = none: events default to the third-party class and model-supplied provenance can only restrict. direct = every call originates in a turn with the authenticated principal and this deployment stands behind the model's authorship labelling as its own. Attested by the host, not verified by veracium: a server reachable by a public or untrusted agent must leave it unset. Any other value refuses to start.
